records.title: Why I Moved My XRP Off Exchanges — Kamilah Stevenson
records.note: The creator says she moved XRP and other long-term positions off exchanges to a brokerage model with Caleb & Brown, citing custody, execution quality and slippage. This is a personal claim/opinion and contains promotional/affiliate material; no independent wallet proof or aggregate exchange-flow evidence.

records.title: Something Just Broke in Global Finance — And It's Connected to XRP — Kamilah Stevenson
records.note: The creator links Middle East oil disruptions, the yen carry trade, global liquidity and XRP, including the opinion that XRP is suited to moments of financial infrastructure stress. This is a macro narrative, not primary evidence of capital flows, XRP payment volume or a causal price effect.

records.title: You Can't Outwork Inflation—Why I Own XRP & Bitcoin Instead — Kamilah Stevenson
records.note: The creator presents a personal inflation/wealth-positioning thesis and says she owns XRP and Bitcoin. This is personal opinion and promotional content; holdings and performance are not independently verified.

records.title: The Shift Just Began… Crypto Is Next — Kamilah Stevenson
records.note: The creator discusses the end of quantitative tightening, PMI and macro liquidity with a broad crypto thesis. No XRP-specific executed-flow evidence or independently scored forecast outcome is captured.
